Olivia (CSM): Heads-up — VeloxHR renewal in 28 days. Onboarding stalled: only 35% of seats activated, two integrations failed during setup. Account health showing repeated login errors in their staging env. Need a short, concrete save plan and owners.
Marcus (CS Ops): Ok — quick triage: 1) stop-gap downgrade path to keep them onboard, 2) focused enablement sessions, 3) targeted bugfix for the staging login errors.
Olivia (CSM): +1. Can we avoid blanket discount unless we have a milestone-based rollback?
Priya (Renewals): Agree — propose a 30-day save plan: milestone 1 = integrations green, milestone 2 = 70% seat activation, milestone 3 = contract reaffirmed. Offer a one-time 10% concession tied to milestone 2 only.
Jamie (AE): I can own the commercial touchpoint. I'll prepare the concession wording and send the updated SOW.
Ben (DevEx): I'll spin up a short enablement playbook + recording for VeloxHR devs and run a 2-hr office hours session. Link to draft: https://docs.redwood/velox-quickstart (will update after session).
Marcus (CS Ops): For downgrade path, suggest "Core" plan with data export and 1-week retention on advanced features; preserves revenue while buying time. Capture steps below:
```
- set billing to Core-tier transitional SKU
- gate advanced features by account flag
- enable export-of-data job for customer admins
- schedule check-in after 14 days
```
Olivia (CSM): Good. Also need engineering triage for the staging login errors — it's blocking integration milestone. Marcus, can you assign?
Marcus (CS Ops): Assigned to infra-eng queue, ticket #INF-4982. ETA hotfix 48h. I'll ping eng on slack and escalate if blocked.
onboard-bot: VeloxHR reached milestone: initial onboarding checklist completed (5/9 items) — remaining: integrations (2), seat invites (4).
Priya (Renewals): Timeline: week 0 = triage + hotfix; week 1 = enablement + milestone 1 verification; week 2 = seat push + milestone 2; week 3 = renewal outreach. If any milestone misses, we move to concession + extended trial.
Ben (DevEx): I'll produce a 20-min howto for the failing integration and a short script they can run. Will drop in the shared folder by EOD.
Jamie (AE): I'll schedule a renewal call for day 21 to confirm intent — invite RevOps and CSM.
Olivia (CSM): Owners: Marcus = infra/execution, Ben = enablement deliverables, Jamie = commercial, Priya = negotiation cadence. Tracker: https://sheets.redwood/velox-saveplan (Marcus populate rows).
Marcus (CS Ops): Populated. Added status column + next action owner.
Olivia (CSM): Capture customer feedback ask: 3 quick questions post-hotfix (why stopped, top 2 blockers, what would make them stay). Ben can add to enablement follow-up.
Ben (DevEx): Will add survey and short link.
Priya (Renewals): I'll draft concession language that ties to the 70% seat metric.
Olivia (CSM): Thanks everyone — primary goal: avoid churn, measure progress weekly. Next sync Thu 11am.
Jamie (AE): :thumbsup:
Marcus (CS Ops): Noted. Updating ticket and sheet.
Olivia (CSM): I'll follow up in-thread with customer-facing timeline after we confirm hotfix.
